start: Admin app, Workout plans, a gym on Pro with a plan open for editing

steps.action: The owner opens an exercise in the plan and pastes a YouTube link (https://youtu.be/abc123) as its form video
user_sees: The link sits on the exercise
must_not: Any link other than https YouTube accepted

steps.action: Save the plan (the admin app sends it with crm_push; the server checks it with _workout_plan_ok)
user_sees: The plan saves as before, with the video on that exercise
must_not: The plan saved without the link while the screen says it was saved
The whole plan refused because of a valid YouTube link

steps.action: A member assigned this plan opens it on their phone
user_sees: 'Watch your trainer' on that exercise
must_not: The button on an exercise that has no link

start: Admin app, Workout plans, an exercise being edited

steps.action: Paste a link that is not https YouTube (http://youtube.com/..., an Instagram link, youtube.com:8080, a user@host link, or 301 characters)
user_sees: The admin app says the link is not allowed (same rule as the server, trainerVideos.ts)
must_not: The bad link saved

steps.action: Force the save anyway from an older admin app
user_sees: The save is refused as INVALID
must_not: The plan saved with the bad link
Other edits to the plan lost without a word

start: Admin app, Workout plans, an exercise that already has a video

steps.action: Clear the video link (or replace it with another YouTube link) and save
user_sees: The exercise shows no link (or the new one)
must_not: The old link kept on the server

steps.action: The member pulls their plans again
user_sees: 'Watch your trainer' gone (or opens the new video)
must_not: The phone still opens the removed video

must_not: The button on exercises without a video

user_sees: The YouTube video opens
must_not: A link that fails the YouTube rule opened (apps/mobile/src/shop/trainerVideo.ts)
